subtitle: Under the shadow of Pratapgad, a cautious lion meets a seasoned hawk

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of Pratapgad looming over dense forest, with Shivaji in the foreground half in shadow
panels.action: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj stands alert on a rocky ledge beneath Pratapgad, hand on his sword, as mist coils around the dark fort walls above the tangled Javali hills.

dialogue.text: In 1659, beneath Pratapgad’s dark ramparts, Shivaji met Afzal Khan in a single parley that ended a general’s life, crushed a Bijapur army, and still divides the chroniclers’ pens.

i18n.hi: १६५९ में, प्रतापगढ़ की काली क़िलाबंदी के नीचे, शिवाजी और अफज़ल ख़ान की एक ही भेट ने एक सरदार की जान ली, बीजापुर की फ़ौज तोड़ी, और आज तक इतिहास बाँट दिया।

panels.shot: wide aerial shot of the rugged Javali-Mahabaleshwar hill country at dawn
panels.action: The camera glides over deep ravines, thick forests, and jagged ridges of the Javali hills, with a winding path snaking towards the distant bastion of Pratapgad.

dialogue.text: The Javali hills were a maze of ravines and forests, a harsh land between the Konkan and the Deccan, where Shivaji’s small kingdom took root among cliffs and torrents.

i18n.hi: जावली की पहाड़ियाँ घाटियों‑जंगलों की भूलभुलैया थीं – कोंकण और दक्खिन के बीच की करड़ी धरती, जहाँ शिवाजी का नन्हा राज्य चट्टानों और धारे में जड़ें जमाता था।

panels.shot: mid-wide of the Bijapur court hall, slightly low angle to emphasize authority
panels.action: In the Bijapur darbar, nobles in rich robes sit in rows as an Adilshahi officer unfolds a map of the western Deccan before the throne dais.

dialogue.text: To the Adilshahi court of Bijapur, Shivaji was a troublesome jagirdar’s son, turning a Mores’ fief and hill forts into an independent power, raiding and fortifying without permission.

i18n.hi: बीजापुर की आदिलशाही दरबार को शिवाजी बस एक झंझटू जागीरदार का लड़का था, जो मोरेयों की जागीर और घाट क़िले को अपनी ताक़त बनाकर, बिना इजाज़त लूट‑कस और क़िलेबंदी कर रहा था।

panels.shot: medium shot focused on Afzal Khan in the Bijapur court, three-quarter view
panels.action: Afzal Khan, a tall, broad-shouldered general with a trimmed beard and heavy paigah turban, stands before the throne, one hand on his sword, the other resting on the map.

dialogue.text: Afzal Khan, veteran of southern wars and a trusted Adilshahi general, was chosen to break this rising hill chief, not as a holy warrior, but as the Sultan’s political hammer.

i18n.hi: दक्खिन के युद्धों का बूढ़ा पठानी, भरोसेमंद आदिलशाही सरदार अफज़ल ख़ान चुना गया – इस पहाड़ी सरदार को तोड़ने के लिए, जिहादी नहीं, सुलतान के सियासी हथौड़े की तरह।

panels.shot: wide shot of Afzal Khan’s marching camp in the plains, slightly high angle
panels.action: A vast Bijapuri camp stretches across the plain, with cavalry lines, artillery carts, and long files of infantry moving as dust rises under a harsh sun.

dialogue.text: With thousands of cavalry, artillery, and camp followers, Afzal Khan marched west. His orders were clear: draw Shivaji down from his forts, break his following, restore Adilshahi control.

i18n.hi: हज़ारों सवार, तोपें और लश्कर लेकर अफज़ल ख़ान पश्चिम को चला। हुक्म साफ़ थे – शिवाजी को क़िलों से नीचे खींचो, उसकी टोली तोड़ो, और आदिलशाही हुकूमत फिर बैठाओ।

panels.shot: mid-wide of Afzal Khan’s force passing a small hillside shrine, side view
panels.action: Afzal Khan’s soldiers move past a modest hill temple; some men are shown toppling a flagstaff and pushing over small stone idols as officers look on.

dialogue.text: Maratha bakhars later told of shrines and temples desecrated along his path, a tale of deliberate provocation; hostile Bijapur records are silent, and historians weigh tactic against legend.

i18n.hi: मराठा बख़रों में रास्ते भर टूटे देवालय और रोंदे मंदिरों की कथा है, जानबूझ कर छेड़ने की बात; दुश्मन बीजापुरी काग़ज़ ख़ामोश हैं, इतिहासकार चाल और दंतकथा दोनों तौलते हैं।

panels.shot: medium interior shot in a stone hall of Pratapgad, eye-level
panels.action: Inside a rough stone chamber, Shivaji sits on a simple seat, leaning over a map lit by a single oil lamp, his face tense yet composed.

dialogue.text: High in Pratapgad, Shivaji watched Afzal Khan’s slow advance. His forces were fewer, his forts strong, his mind sharpened by years of guerrilla war and broken promises.

i18n.hi: ऊपर प्रतापगढ़ में, शिवाजी अफज़ल ख़ान की धीमी चढ़ाई देखते रहे – सेना कम, क़िले मजबूत, और दिमाग़ बरसों की गनिमी लड़ाई और टूटी क़समों से तेज़।

panels.shot: extreme close-up on Shivaji’s eyes, slow push-in
panels.action: Shivaji’s eyes gleam in the lamp light, thoughtful and wary, as shadows from the flame flicker across his brow.

dialogue.text: He knew Afzal Khan’s reputation: brave, ruthless, skilled in court intrigue. A straight battle in the open would favor Bijapur. The hills, and caution, would be his allies.

i18n.hi: उन्हें अफज़ल ख़ान का नाम मालूम था – दिलेर, सख़्त, दरबारी चालों में उस्ताद। खुली मैदानी जंग बीजापुर के हक़ में जाती। पहाड़ और सावधानी ही उनके सच्चे साथी थे।

panels.shot: medium shot of Shivaji addressing unseen commanders, three-quarter angle
panels.action: Shivaji rises from the map, one hand raised in quiet emphasis, as shadowy outlines of his commanders listen in the background.

dialogue.speaker: chhatrapati_shivaji_maharaj
dialogue.text: We will not meet his army. We will meet the man.

i18n.hi: हम उसकी फ़ौज से नहीं, आदमी से भिड़ेंगे।

panels.shot: wide shot of Pratapgad and its slopes, with hidden troops indicated by positioning, not labels
panels.action: The slopes below Pratapgad are shown with Maratha troops concealed among rocks and trees, cavalry clustered in the folds of the hillside, cannons on bastions aimed downslope.

dialogue.text: Shivaji made Pratapgad his shield. He strengthened the fort, hid light troops in the woods, laid paths for a downhill charge, and kept his heavier horse in reserve on the heights.

i18n.hi: शिवाजी ने प्रतापगढ़ को ढाल बनाया। क़िला और सख़्त किया, हल्की टोलियाँ जंगलों में छुपाईं, ढलान पर धावे के रास्ते बनाए, और भारी घुड़सवार ऊँचाइयों पर रोक रखे।

panels.shot: mid-wide of Afzal Khan’s camp below the hills, dusk lighting
panels.action: Afzal Khan’s richly furnished tent stands amid rows of pitched tents; he sits with officers as a messenger bows, holding a letter sealed with wax.

dialogue.text: Afzal Khan’s army reached the Wai region and camped near the Javali hills. Between threats and offers, messages moved, until both sides agreed to a personal meeting.

i18n.hi: अफ़ज़ल ख़ान की फ़ौज वई इलाक़े तक पहुँची और जावली के पास डेरा डाला। धमकी और लालच के बीच चिट्ठियाँ चलती रहीं, जब तक दोनों ने आमने‑सामने की भेट मान ली।

panels.shot: medium shot inside Afzal Khan’s tent, focused on his expression
panels.action: Afzal Khan leans back on cushions, his heavy face calm but mistrustful, as he listens to a cautious adviser gesturing with his hands.

dialogue.text: Later Maratha narratives say Afzal planned treachery. Bijapur accounts insist Shivaji did. What the records agree on is this: both men walked into the grove expecting danger.

i18n.hi: बाद के मराठा आख्यान कहते हैं, अफ़ज़ल ने ही दग़ा ठानी थी; बीजापुरी क़िस्से कहते हैं, चाल शिवाजी ने चली। जो बात सब मानते हैं, वह बस इतनी – दोनों बाग़ में ख़तरे को पहचान कर पहुँचे।

panels.shot: medium shot of Shivaji arming himself in a small stone room, three-quarter angle
panels.action: In a narrow chamber, Shivaji is shown fastening a fine mail shirt under his robe, slipping a small weapon into his sash, his jaw set.

dialogue.text: Maratha bakhars tell of a hidden coat of mail, an iron cap under the turban, and the bagh-nakh, claw-like blades strapped to the hand. The image is powerful, but the sources differ.

i18n.hi: मराठा बख़रों में गुपचुप जिरह‑बख़्तर, पगड़ी के नीचे लोहे की टोपी और हाथ से बँधे वाघ‑नख का ज़िक्र है – तस्वीर ज़ोरदार है, मगर बातें एक‑सी नहीं।

panels.shot: medium close-up on Shivaji’s hands adjusting his turban, slight low angle
panels.action: Shivaji tightens his turban, fingers steady, as a faint line of sweat glistens at his temple in the lantern’s glow.

dialogue.text: Bijapur chroniclers speak instead of a sword or dagger stroke. Between these hostile pens, historians see less a courtroom record, more a memory of caution armed for betrayal.

i18n.hi: बीजापुर के इतिहास में इसके बदले तलवार या बर्छी का वार है। इन दुश्मन क़लमों के बीच, इतिहास को अदालत नहीं, बस ऐहतियात से लैस शक का नक़्श नज़र आता है।

panels.shot: wide shot of the forest path leading to the meeting spot, with Shivaji descending
panels.action: Shivaji rides down a narrow forest path, surrounded by a few close retainers who halt at a distance, as the trees open towards a small clearing below.

dialogue.text: On 10 November 1659, Shivaji left the security of stone walls and marched down into the trees, trusting not in oaths, but in preparation and the terrain he knew.

i18n.hi: १० नवंबर १६५९ को शिवाजी पत्थर की दीवारें छोड़, पेड़ों के बीच उतरे – सहारों पर नहीं, अपनी तैयारियों और पहचानी ज़मीन पर भरोसा करके।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot of the meeting pavilion in the grove, balanced composition
panels.action: A simple canopy stands in a wooded clearing, carpets laid beneath; Afzal Khan approaches from one side with a small escort halted at a distance, while Shivaji nears from the other.

dialogue.text: A pavilion was set up in a grove below Pratapgad. Each side agreed to bring only a few men close, leaving their main forces further off, the air thick with distrust.

i18n.hi: प्रतापगढ़ के नीचे बाग़ में एक शामियाना तना। तय हुआ कि दोनों तरफ़ से चंद आदमी ही पास आएँगे, बाकी फ़ौजें दूर रहें – हवा शक से भारी थी।

panels.shot: medium shot of Shivaji entering the canopy, eye-level
panels.action: Shivaji steps onto the carpet under the canopy, his robes modest but neat, eyes scanning every detail as he inclines his head in greeting.

dialogue.text: Sabhasad and other bakhars paint the scene in vivid strokes: the young hill king in simple robes, the seasoned general in rich finery, both masked by courtesy.

i18n.hi: सभासद और दूसरे बख़रकार इसे गाढ़े रंगों से भरते हैं – साधे वेश में जवान घाटी‑राजा, और रेशमी शान में बूढ़ा सरदार, दोनों के चेहरों पर तहज़ीब की नक़ाब।

panels.shot: medium shot of Afzal Khan inside the canopy, three-quarter low angle
panels.action: Afzal Khan stands tall within the canopy, broad frame draped in embroidered cloth, stretching out his arms as if to embrace an approaching guest.

dialogue.text: Afzal Khan, taller and heavier, is shown in tradition as opening his arms for an embrace, the courtly gesture of reconciliation that could hide both dagger and grip.

i18n.hi: रिवायत में अफ़ज़ल ख़ान, ऊँचा‑तगड़ा, बाँहें फैलाकर गले लगाने को बढ़ता दिखता है – सुलह की दरबारी रस्म, जिसके पीछे न छुरा दिखता है, न पकड़।

panels.shot: tight two-shot of Shivaji and Afzal Khan beginning the embrace, slightly low angle
panels.action: Shivaji and Afzal Khan lean in towards each other in a formal embrace, faces close, each man’s hand partially hidden by flowing sleeves and sashes.

dialogue.speaker: chhatrapati_shivaji_maharaj
dialogue.text: We are both servants of our fortunes, Khan sahib.

i18n.hi: हम दोनों अपनी‑अपनी किस्मत के नौकर हैं, ख़ान साहब।

panels.shot: extreme close-up on their joined torsos and hidden hands, frozen just before the strike
panels.action: The camera tightens on their midsection, hinting at concealed steel beneath cloth, muscles tensed, the moment balanced on a heartbeat.

dialogue.text: Maratha chroniclers declare Afzal Khan first crushed Shivaji in his grip, drew a blade, and struck. Bijapur writers insist Shivaji cut first. The instant itself is lost to us.

i18n.hi: मराठा क़लम कहती है, पहले अफ़ज़ल ने पकड़ कसकर शिवाजी को दबोचा, फिर छुरा खींच वार किया; बीजापुर लिखता है, कट पहली चाल शिवाजी ने चली। वह पल हमारी पकड़ से बाहर है।

panels.shot: medium shot of Shivaji breaking away from Afzal Khan, dynamic diagonal composition
panels.action: Shivaji twists away from Afzal Khan’s collapsing form, cloak swirling, as he calls out towards the trees where his hidden guards wait.

dialogue.text: All records, however hostile, agree on what followed: Afzal Khan was mortally wounded in that embrace, and Shivaji broke free, the parley exploding into battle.

i18n.hi: इतना तो सब दुश्मन काग़ज़ भी मानते हैं – उसी गले में अफज़ल ख़ान घातक रूप से ज़ख़्मी हुआ, और शिवाजी छूट निकले। भेट एक झटके में जंग बन गई।

panels.shot: wide shot of the grove as Maratha bodyguards rush in, slightly high angle
panels.action: Armed Maratha bodyguards rush from behind trees towards the canopy, while Afzal Khan’s shocked attendants reach for their swords amidst sudden chaos.

dialogue.text: Shivaji’s close guards, waiting in the trees, stormed the canopy. Afzal Khan’s attendants fought, fled, or were seized, the planned negotiation turning in an instant into a killing ground of commanders.

i18n.hi: पेड़ों में छुपे शिवाजी के अंगरक्षक बिजली की तरह शामियाने पर टूट पड़े। अफ़ज़ल के साथी लड़े, भागे, या काबू में आ गए – तय बातचीत फ़ौरन सरदारों की क़त्लगाह बनी।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye wide of the battlefield below Pratapgad as fighting begins
panels.action: From above, Maratha contingents pour down the slopes from Pratapgad towards Afzal Khan’s bewildered army, which reels and scrambles to form lines in the valley.

dialogue.text: Signals flashed from the grove to the fort. From Pratapgad’s heights, Shivaji’s light infantry and cavalry surged downhill, striking Afzal Khan’s army while its chief lay fallen.

i18n.hi: बाग़ से क़िले तक निशानियाँ गईं। प्रतापगढ़ की चोटी से शिवाजी की हल्की पैदल और घुड़सवारियाँ ढलान पर टूटीं, उसी वक़्त अफ़ज़ल की सेना पर, जब उसका सरदार ज़मीन पर था।

panels.shot: dynamic mid-wide of Maratha horsemen charging downhill, three-quarter view
panels.action: Maratha horsemen, lean and lightly armored, charge down a slope, spears leveled, as bewildered Bijapur horse try to turn their heavy mounts uphill.

dialogue.text: The terrain that had seemed a trap for Shivaji became a trap for Afzal Khan. Heavy Bijapur horse and artillery struggled on the broken slopes; Maratha riders knew every fold and tree.

i18n.hi: जो ज़मीन शिवाजी के लिए फंदा लगती थी, वही अफ़ज़ल ख़ान के लिए फाँस बन गई। भारी बीजापुरी घोड़े और तोपें टेढ़ी ढलानों में अटक गए; मराठा सवार हर मोड़ और पेड़ से वाक़िफ़ थे।

panels.shot: mid-wide focused on a Bijapur officer rallying troops, with Maratha attack visible
panels.action: A Bijapur officer shouts and raises his sword, trying to rally disordered infantry as Maratha troops close in from flank and front.

dialogue.text: Bijapur sources concede the disaster. Many officers fell, units broke, and Afzal Khan’s army, struck in confusion and without its general, began to crumble and flee.

i18n.hi: ख़ुद बीजापुर के काग़ज़ इस तबाही को मानते हैं – कई सरदार गिरे, टुकड़ियाँ टूटीं, और सरदार से महरूम, उलझी सेना ढहकर भागने लगी।

panels.shot: wide shot of the battlefield’s aftermath, smoke hanging low, bodies implied but not detailed
panels.action: The hillside battlefield lies quiet after the fight, with discarded weapons, overturned carts, and exhausted soldiers sitting or standing in small groups amid lingering smoke.

dialogue.text: The Akhbarat of the Mughal court later reported the news: Afzal Khan killed, his army routed, Shivaji’s fame rising. In Delhi and Bijapur alike, the hill chief could no longer be dismissed.

i18n.hi: दिल्ली दरबार की अख़बारात ने बाद में ख़बर लिखी – अफ़ज़ल ख़ान मारा गया, उसकी फ़ौज भाग निकली, शिवाजी का नाम ऊँचा उठा। दिल्ली हो या बीजापुर, अब यह घाटी‑सरदार अनदेखा नहीं था।

panels.shot: medium shot of Shivaji standing among captured Bijapur soldiers, eye-level
panels.action: Shivaji stands among lines of disarmed Bijapur soldiers, some dejected, some fearful; he gestures calmly as Maratha officers listen for orders.

dialogue.text: Yet victory did not end in slaughter. Contemporary accounts and later tradition agree that many captured Bijapuri soldiers were spared, enrolled, or released with provisions.

i18n.hi: पर फ़तह क़त्लेआम पर खत्म नहीं हुई। उस ज़माने के काग़ज़ और बाद की रिवायतें मानती हैं कि बहुत से पकड़े गए बीजापुरी सिपाही या तो छोड़े गए, या रोज़ी‑रोटी देकर साथ रखे गए।

panels.shot: medium close-up of Shivaji addressing a kneeling Bijapur officer, gentle three-quarter angle
panels.action: A Bijapur officer kneels before Shivaji, who looks down with a firm but restrained expression, one hand open in a gesture of measured mercy.

dialogue.speaker: chhatrapati_shivaji_maharaj
dialogue.text: Your loyalty to your master is not shame. Serve justly, wherever you go.

i18n.hi: अपने मौला से वफ़ादारी शर्म नहीं। जहाँ भी रहो, इंसाफ़ से सेवा करो।

panels.shot: wide shot of Pratapgad at sunset, with Shivaji on the ramparts, silhouetted
panels.action: Shivaji stands on Pratapgad’s rampart at sunset, looking out over the valleys where the battle was fought, the sky burning orange behind his silhouette.

dialogue.text: Pratapgad changed the map of the Deccan. Shivaji had struck down a powerful general, seized guns and horses, and proved that a hill polity could humble a greater state.

i18n.hi: प्रतापगढ़ ने दक्खिन का नक़्श बदल दिया। शिवाजी ने एक तगड़े सरदार को गिराया, तोपें‑घोड़े छीन लिए, और दिखा दिया कि पहाड़ी राज भी बड़े सल्तनतों को झुका सकता है।

panels.shot: montage-like wide shot showing distant cities of Bijapur and Delhi under the same sky
panels.action: Under one sweep of sky, the domes of Bijapur and the walls of Delhi are shown far apart, tiny figures of courtiers gathered in each, gesturing over news scrolls.

dialogue.text: In the years ahead, Mughal emperors and Adilshahi sultans would cite Pratapgad in letters and plans, calculating how to contain a leader who joined boldness to preparation.

i18n.hi: आने वाले बरसों में मुग़ल बादशाह हों या आदिलशाही सुलतान, चिट्ठियों और चालों में बार‑बार प्रतापगढ़ का हवाला देंगे – सोचते हुए कि इस जिगर और तैयारी वाले सरदार को कैसे रोका जाए।

panels.shot: extreme close-up on Shivaji’s profile in shadow, calm and reflective
panels.action: Shivaji’s face is seen in profile in soft shadow, eyes distant, as the faint outline of Pratapgad’s walls frames him in the background.

dialogue.text: The grove below Pratapgad reminds us that courage need not be reckless; Shivaji’s contested stroke endures as a lesson that in a world of larger powers, foresight and caution can turn a single meeting into a turning of history.

i18n.hi: प्रतापगढ़ के नीचे का वही बाग़ याद दिलाता है कि दिलेरी बेअक़्ली नहीं होती; शिवाजी की विवादित चाल आज भी सबक देती है – कि बड़े साम्राज्यों की दुनिया में, दूरअंदेशी और एहतियात एक अकेली भेट को भी इतिहास मोड़ने वाली घड़ी बना सकते हैं।

subtitle_i18n.hi: प्रतापगढ़ की छाँव में, सावधान शेर, बूढ़े बाज़ से मिलता है
